title: Monastic

inlines.v: MONAS'TIC MONAS'TICAL, adjective [Low Latin monasticus; Gr. sole, separate.] Pertaining to monasteries, monks and nuns; recluse; secluded from the temporal concerns of life and devoted to religion; as a monastic life; monastic orders. MONAS'TIC, noun A monk.
